title: TestCollection
description: TestCollection represents a collection of top-level suites and tests in a suite or a module. It also provides useful methods to iterate over itself.

entries.name: TestCollection
entries.description: TestCollection represents a collection of top-level suites and tests in a suite or a module. It also provides useful methods to iterate over itself.

children.name: size
children.description: The number of tests and suites in the collection.
notes: WARNINGThis number includes only tests and suites at the top-level, it doesn't include nested suites and tests.

children.name: at
children.description: Returns the test or suite at a specific index. This method accepts negative indexes.
signatures: function at(index: number): TestCase | TestSuite | undefined

examples.code: function at(index: number): TestCase | TestSuite | undefined

children.name: array
children.description: The same collection but as an array. This is useful if you want to use Array methods like map and filter that are not supported by the TaskCollection implementation.

children.name: allSuites
children.description: Filters all suites that are part of this collection and its children.

children.name: allTests
children.description:
Filters all tests that are part of this collection and its children.

You can pass down a state value to filter tests by the state.
signatures: function allTests(state?: TestState): Generator<TestCase, undefined, void>

examples.code: function allTests(state?: TestState): Generator<TestCase, undefined, void>

children.name: tests
children.description: Filters only the tests that are part of this collection. You can pass down a state value to filter tests by the state.
signatures: function tests(state?: TestState): Generator<TestCase, undefined, void>

examples.code: function tests(state?: TestState): Generator<TestCase, undefined, void>

children.name: suites
children.description: Filters only the suites that are part of this collection.
